subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails` be suppressed before mutating-warning handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: Current tests and the PR's stated behavior disagree on whether detailed exec warnings are useful user-facing output, so automation cannot safely rewrite the branch and tests without maintainer intent.

options.title: Clarify and Repair Policy First
options.body: Decide the desired exec-like detail policy, then move or narrow the suppression branch and update tests to match that contract.

options.title: Preserve Detail-Visible Behavior
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec warnings visible and narrow or close the linked issue if the suppress-all request is not desired.

options.title: Accept Suppress-All Direction
options.body: Allow exec-like suppression to override mutating handling, but require focused tests and real behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Clarify and Repair Policy First
recommendation.body: Decide the desired exec-like detail policy, then move or narrow the suppression branch and update tests to match that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties this handle to the payload and mutation surfaces that define the warning policy.
